# 50% with and without outcome

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  warning = FALSE,
  message = FALSE
)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(glmnet)
library(readr)
library(ggh4x)
proj_root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file_pattern("\\.Rproj$"))
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = proj_root)
```

## Model results
### Functions
```{r}
# Required functions
source("analysis/03_functional_regression/elasticnet_functions.R")
```

### Inputs
```{r}
# Required inputs
name_binding <- "a50_ay_an_binding"
name_condition   <- "a50_ay_an"

brain_csv   <- "data/03_functional_regression/meg_probability_difference.csv"
binding_csv <- "data/03_functional_regression/perceptual_shift_difference.csv"

out_filtered_csv <- "results/03_functional_regression/50_with_without_outcome.csv"

```

### Settings
```{r}
# Time range in ms
time_lower_ms <- 0
time_upper_ms <- 1500
time_windows_ms <- c(10, 20, 40)

# ElasticNet alpha grid for glmnet
alpha_grid <- seq(0.1, 1.0, by = 0.1)

# glmnet settings
n_lambda <- 100
intercepts <- c(TRUE, FALSE)

```


### Run
```{r}
# 1) Read data
brain_long <- read_csv(brain_csv, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")) %>%
  filter(condition == name_condition) %>%
  mutate(region = make_region_label(region))

binding_df <- read_csv(binding_csv, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8")) %>%
  select(subject, all_of(name_binding))

# 2) Build binned features
feature_df <- prep_brain_features(
  brain_long = brain_long,
  time_windows_ms = time_windows_ms,
  time_lower_ms = time_lower_ms,
  time_upper_ms = time_upper_ms
)

# Optional: restrict to target regions
regions <- sort(unique(feature_df$region))

# 3) Fit ElasticNet grid (all lambdas)
all_models <- run_elasticnet_grid(
  feature_df = feature_df,
  binding_df = binding_df,
  regions = regions,
  time_windows_ms = time_windows_ms,
  alpha_grid = alpha_grid,
  intercepts = intercepts,
  binding_col = name_binding,
  n_lambda = n_lambda
)


# 4) Filter by consecutive constraint
# Consecutive constraint for filtering
conti_p_list <- list(
  'AG-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'DLPFC-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'Insula-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  "SMA-R"    = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  "PreSMA-R" = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  "PreSMA-L" = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'Postcentral-L' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),    
  'MTG-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'Precuneus-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3), 
  'Precentral-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'Postcentral-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'SPG-L' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3),
  'STG-R' = list("10" = 4, "20" = 3, "40" = 3)
)

filtered_models <- filter_elasticnet_by_consecutive(
  all_models_df = all_models,
  conti_p_list = conti_p_list,
  time_lower_ms = time_lower_ms,
  time_upper_ms = time_upper_ms,
  consecutive_mode = "strict"
)

# 5) Post-filter by sparsity + overlap-run constraint
# - Sparsity: per time_window (10/20/40 ms), total selected duration <= 200 ms
# - Overlap-run: the triple-overlap (10 & 20 & 40) contains a continuous run >= 40 ms
#   allowing up to 1–2 missing 10-ms bins (controlled by allowed_gap_bins)
filtered_models_final <- post_filter_sparse_and_overlap_run(
  filtered_models = filtered_models,
  time_windows = c(10, 20, 40),
  max_window_ms = 140,
  min_overlap_run_ms = 30,
  allowed_gap_bins = 0
) %>% 
    mutate(
  coef = pmap_dbl(list(coef, time_window), function(x, y) x/(as.numeric(y)/10))
    ) %>% 
  select(region,time_window,lower,upper,coef)

# Related ROI
unique(filtered_models_final$region)
```

### Save
```{r}
write_csv(filtered_models_final, out_filtered_csv)

cat("Saved:\n", out_filtered_csv, "\n")
```


## Plot

### Functions
```{r}
source("analysis/03_functional_regression/fun_plot_functional_regression.R")
```


### Inputs
```{r}
out_pdf <- "figures/03_functional_regression/50_with_without_outcome.pdf"
meg_mean_name <- 'data/03_functional_regression/plot_data/meg_mean_50.csv'



df_meg_mean <- read_csv(meg_mean_name, locale = locale(encoding = "UTF-8"))
regions_name <- c('STG-R')

border_df <- tibble(
    region = c('STG-R'),
    xmin = c(600),
    xmax = c(640)
)
```

### Run
```{r}
p_left <- plot_left_overlap_panel_50(
  df_meg_mean = df_meg_mean,
  coef_df = filtered_models_final,
  regions_name = regions_name,
  time_min = 0,
  time_max = 1500,
  desired_order_condition = c("a50_ay_ba","a50_an_ba","a50_ay_an"),
 style = list(overlap_fill = c("1"="grey90","2"="grey80","3"="grey40"),
  line_colors  = c('a50_an_ba'="#42a5f5",'a50_ay_ba'="#344fac",'a50_ay_an'="#ff4d6d"),
  line_lty     = c('a50_an_ba'=5,'a50_ay_ba'=5,'a50_ay_an'=1),
  line_labels  = c('a50_an_ba'="50% probability\n(without outcome)",'a50_ay_ba'="50% probability\n(with outcome)",'a50_ay_an'="Difference")
                                   )
)

p_right <- plot_right_nested_50(
  df_meg_mean = df_meg_mean,
  coef_df = filtered_models_final,
  border_df = border_df,
  smooth_span = c('STG-R'=0.4),
  x_break = seq(0, 1500, by = 40)
)

# ----------------------------
# Combine
# ----------------------------
full_plot <-  p_left + p_right + plot_layout(nrow = 1, widths = c(1, 1.2))
```


### Save
```{r}
ggsave(out_pdf, plot = full_plot,width = 13, height = 4, units = "in",device = cairo_pdf, family =  "Arial")

```
